title: Milestone 3: methodology tools, proven with CRAP reduction
description:
## Purpose

Let a methodology ship tools, so an installation that adopts it also learns how to run them. The proving case is a CRAP (Change Risk Anti-Patterns: complexity times untested code) reduction methodology.

## Scope

- `METHODOLOGY.md` frontmatter declares tools: name, command relative to the bundle, and a one-line purpose.
- The assembled agents file lists each active methodology's tools with the exact command to run them from the repository root.
- `kbs methodology run <methodology> <tool> [args]` runs a declared tool with the bundle directory resolved, so agents need not know where the bundle lives.
- A `crap` methodology bundle: guidance on reading CRAP scores and reducing them, plus a tool that reports CRAP for the changed code. Decide during the epic whether it ships built in or as an example bundle.

## Definition of done

Specifications for tool declaration, listing in the agents file, running through `kbs`, and failure on an undeclared tool; the CRAP methodology runs against this repository.
